opening.argument: The record presents Samsung customer service, not an investment or money-making offer. The title frames the subject as “Samsung India Service” and promises, “We'll take care of you, wherever you are.” The campaign description explains that a Samsung engineer attends to a customer complaint in a remote hilly area, while the dialogue asks, “Have you received the tv complaint?” A Samsung-branded service van and worker, television, and waiting viewers support that service-and-community narrative. Nothing described requires payment, requests private credentials, imposes a deceptive participation condition, or records a transaction outcome.

citations.quote: We'll take care of you, wherever you are.
This video shows a story of how a young Samsung Engineer undaunted by rough terrain, attends to a customer complaint in a remote hilly area.
Have you received the tv complaint?
